subject: MapReduce on Numeric Data doesn't reduce

messages.author: d6f40f106a6a3751
messages.subject: MapReduce on Numeric Data doesn't reduce
parts:
#I am attempting to do a simple map that squares a column of data and
a reduce that sums.

#I put a file in HDFS that is all numeric (4 columns). Here is the
code I am attempting:

library(rmr)
library(rhdfs)
hdfs.init()

hdfsData <- "/user/col4.csv"

mrResult <- mapreduce(input=hdfsData, input.format =
make.input.format("csv", sep=","), map=function(k,v)
keyval(k,as.numeric(v)^2))

#All of this works, but when I try this it fails at the very end. Any
ideas?

mrResult <- mapreduce(input=hdfsData, input.format =
make.input.format("csv", sep=","), map=function(k,v)
keyval(k,as.numeric(v)^2), reduce = function(k,v) keyval(k,
sum(as.numeric(v))))

#How do I get RHadoop to process numeric data in a mapreduce?

messages.subject: Re: MapReduce on Numeric Data doesn't reduce
parts:
Please follow the debugging guidelines, switch to local mode, rerun your job, debug, provide a reproducible test case, provide a real error message,  not Error:NA. I bet this is a basic R error and I bet it will be obvious in local mode. Thanks


Antonio
